info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Insurance Claims Claims Adjusters-v5-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Adjuster Listing API enables users to access a comprehensive list of insurance claims adjusters associated with various claims. This API primarily serves insurance companies and claims management software providers who require streamlined access to adjuster information. By leveraging this endpoint, developers can efficiently retrieve details about claims adjusters for reporting and operational purposes. Typical consumers include claims administrators and adjuster coordinators who need to manage relationships and workflows effectively.

get.summary: Retrieve claims associated with a specific adjuster.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all claims that are linked to a given adjuster. You can use this to review and manage claims efficiently.
